title: Partner Account Manager - US
description:
Partnerships Manager

Reports To: VP Sales, North America
Location: North America (remote/hybrid)
Type: Full-time, permanent

About Wingify
Founded in 2009, Wingify was built with a simple mission: to make experimentation and experience optimization accessible to everyone. What began in a New Delhi apartment has grown into a global SaaS platform enabling organizations to improve digital experiences through data-driven experimentation and insight.
Today, Wingify serves thousands of customers—from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 companies like the World Economic Forum, Genpact, Forbes, and LEGO—and is supported by a global team of 450+ employees, with ANZ emerging as a key growth region.

Following Wingify’s merger with AB Tasty, the combined organization now forms a larger digital experience optimization platform with $100M+ in annual recurring revenue, 4,000+ customers worldwide, and nearly 800 employees across 11 global offices. Led by Sparsh Gupta as CEO and backed by Everstone, the group is focused on delivering best-in-class experimentation, personalization, and AI-led optimization solutions at global scale.

About the Role
Wingify is expanding its North America Partnerships team. This role starts by working alongside our Director, Partnerships to grow and support the existing strategic partner ecosystem, then takes on full ownership of that book while she is on maternity leave, and continues as a permanent second seat on the team when she returns. It's built as a lasting addition to the partnerships function, not a leave-coverage placeholder — early exposure to the full partner book is intentional so the transition in and out of full ownership is seamless.

Role Summary
Own and grow Wingify's strategic partner ecosystem in North America, driving partner-sourced pipeline, revenue, and retention through structured co-sell, joint GTM, and enablement programs with key technology, agency, and reseller partners.

Key Responsibilities
  • Partner Relationship Management — Serve as a primary point of contact for strategic NA partners; manage relationship health, escalations, and day-to-day partner engagement.
  • Revenue & Retention Accountability — Track and report partner-sourced ARR, renewal/retention performance, and at-risk accounts; own a dedicated Partner KPI dashboard distinct from regional sales reporting.
  • GTM & Co-Sell Strategy — Develop and execute joint go-to-market plans with partners — align on target verticals/tiers/buyers, competitive account lists, and a structured co-sell motion.
  • Joint Marketing & Content — Build and drive joint marketing plans (webinars, events, co-branded content, customer success stories) in partnership with Marketing.
  • Partner Enablement — Support KAM/CSM teams executing renewals with enablement materials, playbooks, and defined support SLAs (rather than open-ended firefighting).
  • New Partner Development — Identify, qualify, and onboard new partnership opportunities (referral, reseller, technology integrations); manage partner agreements, NDAs, and partnership contracts.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment — Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations leadership to represent partnership performance and priorities in NA revenue leadership forums.
  • Reporting & Forecasting — Provide regular updates on partner pipeline, forecast contribution, and program health to sales leadership.

Key Metrics
  • Partner-sourced ARR / new business pipeline
  • Partner-influenced ARR
  • Joint pipeline generated through co-sell/marketing activities
  • Partner program adoption and satisfaction

What Success Looks Like
  • First 90 days: Fully ramped on the existing strategic partner book (relationships, contract terms, active co-sell motions); actively supporting the Director, Partnerships on at least one live initiative (e.g., a joint GTM plan or renegotiation).
  • Ahead of leave transition: Able to run point independently on all top-tier partner relationships and escalations with no drop in cadence.
  • Ongoing (as a permanent second seat): Owns a defined subset of the partner portfolio outright, freeing the Director, Partnerships to focus on net-new strategic partnerships and program-level strategy as the team scales.

Skills & Experience
  • 5+ years managing strategic technology, agency, or reseller partnerships, ideally in CMS, commerce, or MarTech ecosystems
  • Track record owning partner-sourced revenue targets and reporting against them
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and executive-level communication skills
  • Comfortable owning a KPI/reporting cadence and driving accountability across functions without direct authority
  • Experience building joint GTM and marketing plans with external partners
  • Contract/agreement fluency (NDAs, partnership terms, OEM/resell structures) — ability to work alongside deal desk/legal on renegotiations
  • Comfortable stepping into shared ownership of an existing book early, then scaling into full ownership of a portfolio

Nice to Have
  • Experience in a team-expansion or "grow into" role where scope increased over the first year
  • Existing relationships in the digital experience/optimization or MarTech partner ecosystem


At Wingify, we are committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives drives better ideas, stronger execution, and more meaningful impact. Read more about our policy here: https://wingify.com/careers/equal-opportunity-policy/

title: PreSales Solutions Engineer - Enterprise (London)
description:
THE TEAM

Team Name & Location: Solutions Engineers, based in London.
Team Composition: The UK team consists of 2 Solutions Engineers, part of a global team of 4. You will work closely with internal stakeholders like the VP Sales UK, Sales, and Product Managers, and externally with prospects and existing clients.
Role Overview: The Solutions Engineer acts as the technical bridge between prospects and AB Tasty's platform, accelerating the sales cycle and driving enterprise revenue.
Tech Stack & Tools: JS, HTML, CSS, APIs, Loom, Salesforce, Confluence, Realm, Jira.
Additional Information: The role involves travel, mostly within London and across the UK for key prospect meetings.

YOUR MISSION

  • Manage The technical and product relationship with prospects and customers, serving as a trusted point of contact throughout the sales cycle.
  • Build and maintain Tailored solution presentations by analyzing prospect websites and delivering smart, data-driven insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Drive Alignment between market needs and product innovation by providing feedback to product development teams and staying ahead of industry trends.
  • Lead End-to-end pre-sales efforts, from demonstrations and RFP responses to scoping and pricing, with minimal support.
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders and clients to ensure a smooth transition from pre-sales to implementation, while communicating new product capabilities clearly and effectively.
  • Act as the technical voice in high-level discussions with engineering, management, and executive stakeholders, demonstrating value and feasibility of AB Tasty’s solutions.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Proven experience in pre-sales engineering in a SaaS environment, with 5+ years supporting sales and service delivery for enterprise clients.
  • Confidence in customer-facing communication, technical analysis, solution positioning, and navigating complex RFI/RFP processes.
  • Eagerness to combine strong technical foundations (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, web technologies, APIs) with a passion for helping clients unlock product value.
If you don't meet 100% of these qualifications, tell us why you'd still be a great fit for this role in your application!

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT HERE

  • Make a real impact: directly influence our success and be a player in the company's growth
  • Ownership & autonomy: we believe in trust - no micromanagement, just the freedom to excel and take charge of your own journey
  • International culture: collaborate with a diverse, global team across 8 countries
  • Accelerate your career: we offer vast opportunities for professional development, education, and upward mobility
  • Flexible work: enjoy a balanced work schedule, with up to 3 days of remote work per week

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Step 1: Discovery interview with Neha, Talent Acquisition Tem.
  • Step 2: Hiring Manager interview with Edouard, Solution Engineer.
  • Step 3: Case study presentation with a Edouard and Julien VP of Sales Operations
  • Step 4: Final meeting with a member of the team and Will Bashford VP of Sales UK.

title: Partner Success Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Partner Success Manager (PSM) to drive the success, adoption, and long-term engagement of our strategic partners.
As a Partner Success Manager, you will be the primary success partner for an assigned portfolio of partners, helping them build expertise in Wingify’s solutions, successfully support their customers, drive product adoption, and maximize the value of their partnership with us.
Similar to how a Customer Success Manager drives outcomes for customers, you will focus on enabling our partners to become increasingly self-sufficient, knowledgeable, and successful with Wingify’s products and solutions.

You will work closely with Partner Account Managers, Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Support, Product, Technical teams, and Enablement to ensure partners have the knowledge, resources, and support they need to deliver strong outcomes for their customers.
This role combines partner relationship management, enablement, product adoption, value realization, retention, and strategic guidance, with a strong focus on building scalable and successful partner relationships.


What You’ll Do

Partner Success & Relationship Management

  • Own the success, engagement, and overall health of an assigned portfolio of partners.
  • Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders across partner organizations.
  • Develop a strong understanding of each partner’s business model, objectives, capabilities, maturity, and customer portfolio.
  • Create joint success plans with partners and regularly review progress against agreed goals and outcomes.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for partner success-related topics and coordinate the right internal resources when needed.

Partner Enablement & Autonomy

  • Help partners progressively build strong expertise across Wingify’s products, solutions, and best practices.
  • Plan and coordinate new partner onboarding to accelerate time-to-value and establish strong foundations for success.
  • Coordinate product training, certifications, technical enablement, and ongoing education.
  • Help partners understand how to effectively position, implement, and drive adoption of Wingify solutions for their customers.
  • Identify knowledge and capability gaps and create actionable plans to address them.
  • Organize regular product updates, enablement sessions, and upskilling initiatives to strengthen partner capabilities and autonomy.

Product Adoption & Value Realization

  • Monitor partner engagement, product adoption, certification progress, and overall partner health.
  • Track Wingify usage and adoption across partner-managed customer accounts and proactively identify potential risks or gaps.
  • Identify underutilized capabilities and work with partners to develop concrete adoption plans.
  • Share relevant use cases, customer success stories, product updates, and best practices to help partners generate greater value.
  • Use data and insights to identify opportunities to improve adoption, engagement, and customer outcomes.

Retention & Risk Management

  • Proactively identify risks across partner relationships and partner-managed customer accounts.
  • Develop and coordinate action plans with the appropriate internal stakeholders to address risks.
  • Maintain clear visibility into partner and customer account health and escalate issues when required.
  • Partner closely with Partner Account Managers on renewals, retention, and expansion opportunities.
  • Ensure clear ownership and coordination when partner-managed customers require additional support.
  • Consistently document risks, actions, decisions, and next steps in internal systems.

Strategic Partner Reviews

  • Lead regular partner success reviews and contribute to strategic business reviews.
  • Review product adoption, engagement, customer outcomes, risks, opportunities, and agreed priorities.
  • Build actionable success plans with partners and ensure consistent follow-through on commitments.
  • Use data and insights to constructively challenge partners and help improve their performance and customer outcomes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Partner Account Managers to align commercial objectives with partner success priorities.
  • Coordinate with Customer Success Managers when partners are involved in customer accounts.
  • Collaborate with Technical Account Managers, Support, Professional Services, Product, and Enablement teams to resolve blockers and strengthen partner capabilities.
  • Bring structured partner feedback internally and help Product and other teams understand recurring partner needs, challenges, and opportunities.
  • Contribute to continuously improving and scaling our global Partner Success processes, playbooks, and best practices.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience in Customer Success, Partner Success, Account Management, Consulting, or a similar client-facing role, preferably within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
  • Good understanding of SaaS product adoption, customer success, retention, and value realization.
  • Ability to understand partner business models and translate business objectives into actionable success plans.
  • Comfortable working with data and using insights to identify risks, opportunities, and priorities.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple partners and priorities simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Technical, Support, and Professional Services teams.
  • Proactive, structured, and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-moving environment.
  • Fluent written and spoken English; additional languages are a plus.


What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means building partners who are increasingly knowledgeable, autonomous, engaged, and capable of delivering strong outcomes for their customers.
You will help ensure our partners adopt Wingify’s solutions effectively, proactively manage risks, continuously strengthen their capabilities, and build long-term, mutually valuable relationships with Wingify.

title: Senior Key Account Manager - Spain
description:
About Us
We are a leading digital experience optimization platform that helps businesses improve customer experiences through experimentation, personalization, behavioral analytics, and AI-powered insights.
AB Tasty recently joined forces with VWO to create one of the most comprehensive and innovative digital experimentation and experience optimization platforms in the market. Together, we empower brands to deliver smarter, faster, and more impactful digital experiences across the entire customer journey. Since 2009, we've partnered with 1,000+ global brands - Kering, McDonald's, Ulta Beauty, L'Oréal, Disneyland Paris, and LVMH - and built a global team of 400+ across Europe, North America, and APAC.
Our culture is driven by strong values:
  • We bring client satisfaction
  • We are impactful
  • We go above and beyond
  • We live as one team, one dream
We're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels empowered to share ideas, take risks, and make an impact. We also know that a happy team is a productive team, that's why we're not just about delivering top-notch digital experiences - we're committed to nurturing our team and their professional journeys.


The Team
  • Team Name & Location: Sales team, based in Madrid (hybrid work policy, with up to 3 remote days per week).
  • Team Composition: You will join the Sales team and work closely with internal teams (Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Support) and external stakeholders, including key customers across Spain—from operational contacts to Directors and C-level executives at Enterprise accounts.
  • Role Overview: As Senior Key Account Manager, you will own and grow a portfolio of major Enterprise clients (more than €2M) across Spain, driving contract renewals, upselling, and cross-selling while acting as a strategic partner to Directors and C-level stakeholders.
  • Tech Stack & Tools: Salesforce, Gong, Slack, Jira, Confluence, and more.

description:
Role: Salesforce Admin Specialist (Sales Cloud & CPQ)
Work location: Delhi/NCR

Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Admin Specialist with deep functional expertise in Sales Cloud and CPQ. In this role, you will bridge the gap between business strategy and technical execution. You will collaborate directly with business owners to gather requirements, translate operational needs into clear User Stories, oversee developer implementation, coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and ensure end-to-end delivery of high-impact Salesforce solutions.

Key Responsibilities
1. Discovery & Business Consultation
  • Requirement Gathering: Partner directly with business owners and Sales Leadership to capture business goals, operational pain points, and functional requirements.
  • Solution Brainstorming: Lead consultative brainstorming sessions to evaluate existing Sales Cloud and Dealhub CPQ capabilities, designing efficient, scalable business processes.
  • Process Mapping: Map end-to-end business workflows, quote-to-cash processes, approval logic, and pipeline management structures.
2. Requirements Translation & Agile Management
  • User Story Creation: Translate business requirements into detailed functional specs, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria within Jira.
  • Sprint Collaboration: Brief development teams, clarify functional details, and assist in technical estimation and sprint planning.
3. Solution Delivery & Developer Management
  • Hands-On Functional Configuration: Configure core Sales Cloud features and Dealhub CPQ rules..
  • Developer Coordination: Coordinate with Dev team for all development works related to the user stories created and make sure to have timely checks in place.
  • Project Oversight: Drive delivery momentum, ensuring developers stick to project timelines, quality standards, and acceptance criteria.
4. Testing, UAT & Stakeholder Deployment
  • UAT Orchestration: Design test scenarios, author test scripts, and lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) sessions with business stakeholders.
  • Stakeholder Sign-Off: Track defect resolution, collect formal stakeholder approval, and manage change management/end-user enablement before go-live.


Required Qualifications & Skills
  • Salesforce Expertise: 3–6 years of functional experience as a Salesforce Administrator or Business Analyst, with deep hands-on expertise in Sales Cloud.
  • CPQ Core Knowledge: Solid functional understanding of Dealhub  CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) architecture, including Product & Price Rules, Approval Workflows, and Quote Templates.
  • Business Analysis & Agile: Proven experience running discovery workshops, writing user stories with clear acceptance criteria, and working within Agile/Scrum frameworks.
  • Delivery & Testing Leadership: Demonstrated track record of guiding developers through build phases, executing QA, and coordinating end-to-end UAT sign-offs with business leadership.
  • Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills to align non-technical business leaders with technical development teams.
  • Certifications (Preferred): Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM-201), Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant, or Salesforce CPQ Specialist.

title: Lead Engineer - Backend (Data Platform)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer — Backend / Data Platform to provide technical leadership for backend and data-intensive systems powering analytics, reporting, experimentation, and behavioural insights across Wingify <> AB Tasty.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not an engineering management position.
You will continue to design systems and write production code, while also owning architecture and technical direction for significant workstreams.
You will work across Java, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, Redis, Kafka, and GCP, solving problems spanning event ingestion, distributed processing, query engines, analytical storage, low-latency serving, and reporting.
A key part of the role is helping us evolve two mature analytics platforms toward a more unified data foundation without compromising the reliability of systems already serving production customers.


The Engineering Landscape

Our production data platform includes:
  • ClickHouse — self-hosted and ClickHouse Cloud for high-volume analytics and SaaS reporting
  • BigQuery — large-scale analytics and data processing
  • Bigtable — low-latency NoSQL serving
  • Redis — caching, queues, and distributed coordination
  • Kafka — high-volume real-time event streaming
  • GCP — GCS, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, IAM, Secret Manager, GKE and VMs
  • Java — Spring Boot and JVM-based backend services
  • Apache Beam / Dataflow — distributed event and batch processing
  • Go — adjacent SQL and reporting services
Alongside the existing platform, we are building capabilities around:
  • Warehouse-native experiment computation in customer Snowflake/BigQuery environments
  • Cross-platform visitor profiles and identity
  • First-party cohorts and saved audiences
  • Unified metrics across internal and customer warehouses
  • Converging Wingify and AB Tasty analytics onto a common data foundation


What You'll Do

Architecture & System Design

  • Own the technical architecture and design of significant backend/data-platform workstreams.
  • Design distributed systems for high-volume event ingestion, analytical querying, data processing, and low-latency serving.
  • Make architectural decisions around data modelling, storage engines, partitioning, query patterns, caching, streaming, reliability, and cost.
  • Evaluate trade-offs across ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, Redis, Kafka, and other technologies based on workload characteristics.
  • Drive designs that can evolve as the Wingify and AB Tasty platforms converge.

Hands-on Engineering

  • Remain hands-on with Java and production backend code.
  • Build and evolve backend services, query engines, APIs, data pipelines, and distributed processing systems.
  • Write and optimise complex analytical SQL and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks.
  • Solve difficult production problems involving slow queries, data correctness, pipeline failures, latency, throughput, and infrastructure.
  • Work with Kafka, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, GCS, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, and Redis at production scale.
  • Own critical systems through design, implementation, deployment, observability, and operation.

Technical Leadership

  • Set technical direction for a platform area or major engineering workstream.
  • Break ambiguous product and platform requirements into clear technical designs and execution plans.
  • Review architecture and designs from other engineers and challenge assumptions constructively.
  • Establish engineering practices around reliability, scalability, observability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Mentor SSE-1/SSE-2 engineers and help them grow their system-design and production-engineering capabilities.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Infrastructure teams.
  • Influence architecture beyond your immediate projects without requiring formal people-management authority.


What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of hands-on backend/software engineering experience, with substantial experience building distributed or data-intensive systems.
  • Demonstrated ownership of architecture and system design for production systems at meaningful scale.
  • Strong hands-on Java experience, including modern Java and JVM backend systems.
  • Strong experience designing systems around analytical databases, data warehouses, and/or large-scale non-relational stores.
  • Deep understanding of data modelling, partitioning, indexing, clustering, query execution, caching, concurrency, and performance optimisation.
  • Strong SQL and analytical-querying experience.
  • Experience designing and operating streaming/event-driven architectures, ideally using Kafka or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience building batch and/or streaming data pipelines at scale.
  • Strong cloud engineering experience; GCP is preferred.
  • Experience operating production systems with clear SLOs, observability, failure handling, and performance requirements.
  • Strong debugging ability across applications, distributed systems, databases, pipelines, and infrastructure.
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers, reviewing technical designs, and influencing architecture.
  • Ability to balance long-term platform architecture with pragmatic delivery.


Nice to Have

  • Deep production experience with ClickHouse, including schema design, MergeTree engines, partitioning, sorting keys, query optimisation, replication, and performance tuning.
  • BigQuery and Bigtable at significant production scale.
  • Apache Beam / Dataflow.
  • Snowflake or warehouse-native compute architectures.
  • Go, Vert.x, or other high-performance backend technologies.
  • Experience handling billions of events and/or TB–PB scale analytical datasets.
  • Experience with experimentation platforms, A/B testing, funnels, segmentation, identity resolution, cohorts, or behavioural analytics.
  • Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, Prometheus, Grafana, or GCP Cloud Monitoring.


Core Skills

Java · System Design · Distributed Systems · Data Platform · ClickHouse · SQL · BigQuery · Bigtable · Kafka · Redis · GCP · Pub/Sub · Dataflow · ETL · Microservices · Technical Leadership

title: Senior Software Engineer – Full-Stack
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience to join our engineering team and build, maintain, and evolve reliable, scalable software products.
This is a backend-heavy full-stack role. You will primarily work on backend systems and services while also contributing to frontend components, APIs, integrations, and infrastructure when required. The ideal candidate is hands-on, strong at debugging complex production issues, and comfortable working across different layers of a technology stack.
You should have strong experience with PHP and backend development, along with practical exposure to Node.js, SQL, Redis, event-driven systems, and cloud technologies. We are particularly interested in engineers who actively keep up with modern engineering practices and use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, code quality, and problem-solving.
The role will involve working on real-world engineering problems where ownership, sound technical judgment, and the ability to understand and troubleshoot existing systems are as important as writing new code.


What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable, and maintainable backend services and APIs, primarily using PHP.
  • Build and enhance services and integrations using Node.js where appropriate.
  • Work with relational databases and SQL, including schema design, query optimization, indexing, and troubleshooting database performance issues.
  • Design and implement effective caching strategies using Redis for performance, scalability, and distributed application requirements.
  • Work with event-driven and asynchronous architectures, including queues, background jobs, event processing, and related failure-handling patterns.
  • Contribute to frontend development when required, working across the stack to deliver complete product functionality.
  • Investigate and resolve complex production issues, including application, database, infrastructure, performance, and integration-related problems.
  • Analyze logs, traces, metrics, and application behavior to identify root causes, rather than relying only on surface-level fixes.
  • Design solutions that consider performance, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.
  • Work with AWS services and cloud infrastructure to deploy, operate, and troubleshoot applications.
  • Write clean, testable, well-structured code and contribute to improving engineering standards and development practices.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, design reviews, and architectural decisions.
  • Automate repetitive engineering and operational tasks wherever possible.
  • Work closely with Product, QA, Support, and other engineering teams to understand requirements and solve customer-impacting problems.
  • Take ownership of features and technical problems end-to-end, from understanding the problem to implementation, deployment, monitoring, and resolution.
  • Stay current with modern technologies, development practices, and AI-powered engineering tools, and identify opportunities to use them effectively.


Must-Have Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong hands-on production experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with PHP and backend development.
  • Good practical experience with Node.js and building backend services/APIs.
  • Strong understanding of SQL and relational databases, including query optimization, indexing, and database design fundamentals.
  • Hands-on experience with Redis, including caching and/or other key-value use cases.
  • Understanding of event-driven and asynchronous architectures, such as queues, workers, background processing, and event-based communication.
  • Basic working knowledge of AWS and cloud fundamentals, including concepts such as compute, storage, networking, and managed services.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Good understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, authentication, and common backend architecture patterns.
  • Ability to work effectively with an existing codebase, understand unfamiliar systems quickly, and make safe changes in production environments.
  • Strong ownership and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently drive technical problems to resolution.

We are a leading digital experience optimization platform that helps businesses improve customer experiences through experimentation, personalization, behavioral analytics, and AI-powered insights.
AB Tasty recently joined forces with VWO to create one of the most comprehensive and innovative digital experimentation and experience optimization platforms in the market. Together, we empower brands to deliver smarter, faster, and more impactful digital experiences across the entire customer journey. Since 2009, we've partnered with 1,000+ global brands - Kering, McDonald's, Ulta Beauty, L'Oréal, Disneyland Paris, and LVMH - and built a global team of 400+ across Europe, North America, and APAC.
Our culture is driven by strong values:
  • We bring client satisfaction
  • We are impactful
  • We go above and beyond
  • We live as one team, one dream
We're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels empowered to share ideas, take risks, and make an impact. We also know that a happy team is a productive team, that's why we're not just about delivering top-notch digital experiences - we're committed to nurturing our team and their professional journeys.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Manage a portfolio of strategic Enterprise clients, guiding them through onboarding, platform adoption, and long-term optimization initiatives
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with key stakeholders by combining technical understanding with strong business acumen.
  • Drive measurable business outcomes, customer retention, and account growth through shared success plans and value-driven engagement.
  • Lead onboarding, training, and enablement sessions to build client confidence and accelerate time to value.

title: Solutions Strategist - APAC
description:
Solutions Strategist - APAC

The Team

Team: Solutions Strategists, part of Wingify's global PreSales organization
Coverage: APAC - East Asia, South East Asia, ANZ and India
You'll work with: the VP Sales APAC, regional Account Executives and Solutions Engineers, and the Solutions Strategist covering Europe and MEA
Role overview: You will be Wingify's first dedicated Solutions Strategist in APAC, building the strategic PreSales practice for the region from the ground up alongside existing regional Sales and Solutions Engineering teams.

Who We Are

Wingify is a global leader in experimentation, personalization and conversion rate optimization, born from the merger of AB Tasty and VWO. Together, we help some of the world's most ambitious brands turn insight into revenue across every digital touchpoint.
With teams spanning Europe, the Americas, MEA and Asia-Pacific, we partner with enterprise customers across retail, travel, media and financial services to build and scale high-performing CRO and CXO programs. As we grow our Enterprise footprint globally, we're expanding the PreSales organization that makes our biggest deals win.

Your Mission

As a Solutions Strategist, you own the strategic and business narrative on Wingify's most complex Enterprise and strategic deals. You partner with the Account Executive and the Solutions Engineer as one team. Your work is structured around four levers:
•   Differentiate: build one coherent strategic narrative across the entire pre-sales journey, frame competitive differentiation at every step, and strategize ahead of an upcoming opportunity on strategic and key deals.
•   De-Risk: address the perceived risks that stall Enterprise evaluations (switching cost, resourcing, governance readiness, and CRO/CXO maturity) through direct CXO-level conversations
•   Visualize: make Wingify's impact tangible for each specific deal (tailored market and vertical insight, tool/suite fit, use cases built from real analysis of the prospect's business, and competitive positioning.)
•   Prove: turn a ROI model into a business case narrative the Champion can defend in front of Finance, translating gains, savings and break-even into language a CFO expects.
Beyond the four levers, you will:
  • Contribute to the strategic response and differentiation on complex, competitive RFPs.
  • Steer multi-stakeholder POCs and complex evaluations, facilitating decisions across technical and business stakeholders.
  • Act as an evangelist for Wingify at conferences, webinars and workshops.

What You'll Bring

Core Competencies
  • Organizational Diagnosis: Assess an organization's CRO/CXO maturity and political dynamics within a single conversation, asking the right questions to enrich the Sales team's account intelligence.
  • Business & Technical Diagnosis: Spot optimization opportunities at a glance and reframe a functional brief into the 2-3 underlying problems Wingify can solve.
  • Product & Solution Mastery: Understand how our solutions work well enough to quickly assess use case feasibility, propose new ones, and recommend the most relevant products for a prospect's context.
  • Consultative Posture: Hold consultative conversations on the execution of a CRO/CXO strategy, including on challenges peripheral to the tools themselves such as governance, resourcing or process.
  • Narrative & Competitive Positioning: Build a narrative that puts our tools' value into sharp relief and position effectively in an intensely competitive context.

Mindset & Behaviors

  • Active listening and organizational acumen : reads stakeholder dynamics and unspoken politics, not just stated requirements.
  • Analytical thinking and structured problem-solving : synthesizes and prioritizes quickly under ambiguity.
  • Intellectual curiosity and learning agility : genuine appetite to dig into how things work without waiting for all the answers.
  • Consultative presence and executive credibility : comfortable challenging a prospect's thinking without arrogance.
  • Communication and storytelling : clear and compelling at executive level, composed under competitive pressure.
  • Multi-threading and autonomy : manages multiple stakeholders, issues and deals in parallel, structuring the approach on each account independently.
If you don't meet 100% of these qualifications, tell us why you'd still be a great fit for this role in your application!

Why You'll Love It Here

  • Make a Real Impact: sit at the center of Wingify's biggest deals and directly influence win rate and deal size.
  • Ownership & Autonomy: no micromanagement, just the freedom to own your region's strategic deals.
  • International Culture: collaborate with a diverse, global PreSales, Sales and Product organization spanning Europe, the Americas, MEA and APAC.
  • Career Development: vast opportunities for professional growth as Wingify scales its Enterprise footprint globally.

Details

Contract: Permanent, full-time
Location: India
Remote: 100% remote
Reporting line: Solutions Strategist Director

title: Big Data Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Big Data Engineer to design, build, and operate large-scale data pipelines and analytical infrastructure that transform high-volume raw data into reliable, query-ready datasets for analytics, reporting, and data-driven products.
Our data platform ingests and processes data from multiple sources and serves analytics, data science, product, and downstream applications. In this role, you will own data pipelines end-to-end—from ingestion and transformation to warehousing, orchestration, data quality, and observability.
A key part of the role is owning ClickHouse as our primary analytical data store. You will be responsible for designing scalable data models, optimizing query performance, and ensuring the platform remains reliable and cost-efficient as data volumes and workloads grow.
You will work closely with data scientists, analysts, product engineers, and other engineering teams to build a modern, cloud-native data platform.


What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain robust batch and streaming data pipelines that ingest data from multiple sources into analytical data stores.
  • Build and operate Apache Airflow DAGs, including scheduling, dependencies, retries, backfills, idempotency, concurrency, and failure handling.
  • Develop analytics-ready datasets using dbt, following well-structured staging, intermediate, and mart layers with appropriate tests, documentation, and incremental models.
  • Own ClickHouse as the primary analytical store, including:
    • Schema and table design using the MergeTree family of engines
    • Partitioning and sorting/primary key strategies
    • Materialized views
    • Distributed and replicated table architectures
    • Query and memory optimization
    • High-volume data ingestion and performance tuning
  • Work with BigQuery where cloud data-warehouse patterns are appropriate, including data modeling and query/cost optimization.
  • Design and operate NoSQL and key-value data stores, including Bigtable, DynamoDB, and Redis, based on specific access patterns and performance requirements.
  • Build and maintain data-quality frameworks covering validation, testing, freshness, completeness, reconciliation, and anomaly detection.
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, structured logging, and observability for data pipelines and services.
  • Own pipeline SLAs, incident response, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.
  • Manage backfills, safe re-runs, schema evolution, and data migrations while minimizing downstream impact.
  • Build reproducible, containerized environments using Docker and contribute to CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code practices.
  • Partner with analysts, data scientists, product managers, and product engineers to translate business and technical requirements into scalable data models and pipelines.
  • Continuously improve pipeline reliability, scalability, performance, and infrastructure cost efficiency.


Must-Have Requirements

  • 4-6 years of experience in data engineering or a closely related field, with strong hands-on production experience.
  • Expert-level SQL and strong Python skills, with experience writing production-grade, maintainable, and well-tested code.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Apache Airflow or a comparable workflow orchestration platform, including DAG design, scheduling, retries, backfills, dependency management, idempotency, and concurrency.
  • Hands-on experience with dbt or a comparable transformation/ELT framework, including modular models, testing, source management, documentation, and incremental processing.
  • Expert-level production experience with ClickHouse. This is a core requirement and should include:
    • MergeTree engine family
    • Partitioning and primary/sorting keys
    • Materialized views
    • Distributed and replicated tables
    • Query and memory optimization
    • High-volume ingestion and performance tuning
  • Production experience with a cloud-based columnar/OLAP warehouse, such as BigQuery, including data modeling and performance/cost optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with NoSQL and key-value databases, such as Bigtable, DynamoDB, and Redis, including data modeling, partition/key design, access patterns, and caching strategies.
  • Strong understanding of ETL/ELT and dimensional/layered data modeling principles.
  • Experience with GCP and/or AWS and familiarity with Docker, Git, and CI/CD.
  • Strong focus on data quality, reliability, observability, and correctness.
  • Strong ownership, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, analytics, data science, and product teams.


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with search platforms such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Apache Solr, or Vespa, including indexing pipelines, schema design, and relevance/performance tuning.
  • Experience with Aerospike or other high-performance, low-latency distributed key-value/NoSQL systems.
  • Experience building streaming and event-driven pipelines using Kafka, Pub/Sub, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with Change Data Capture (CDC) patterns and technologies.
  • Experience with Apache Spark and data-lake architectures using object storage such as GCS or S3.
  • Experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code tools and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with data-quality and observability tools such as Great Expectations, Soda, Monte Carlo, or advanced dbt testing.
  • Understanding of data platform cost optimization / FinOps practices.
  • Experience handling high-volume e-commerce, product catalog, behavioral, or event data.
  • Familiarity with a second backend programming language, particularly Go.


What Success Looks Like

  • Data pipelines are reliable, well-tested, observable, and consistently meet freshness and completeness SLAs.
  • Data models are clean, scalable, documented, and trusted by analytics, data science, and product teams.
  • Data-quality issues are identified before they impact downstream consumers.
  • Pipeline failures are diagnosed and resolved quickly, with clear root-cause analysis and preventive actions.
  • ClickHouse and the broader analytical platform scale smoothly with growing data volumes and query workloads.
  • Data infrastructure remains performant and cost-efficient as usage grows.
  • Downstream teams can confidently rely on the platform for analytics, reporting, experimentation, and data-driven product experiences.

You will own the agency certification program end-to-end—from developing learning paths and certification content to conducting live training sessions, tracking learner progress, and continuously improving the training experience.

  • Own and manage the Wingify Agency Certification Program, including certification content, assessments, learner tracking, and program enhancements.
  • Create and maintain product training materials, including presentations, documentation, videos, tutorials, and self-paced learning modules.
  • Enable agency partners to effectively use, implement, and position VWO products for their customers.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Customer Success, Presales, and Product Marketing teams to ensure training content reflects the latest product capabilities and best practices.
  • Continuously improve training effectiveness by gathering learner feedback, measuring outcomes, and refining curriculum.
  • Maintain a structured knowledge repository and learning resources for agency partners.
  • Stay up to date with product releases and industry trends in experimentation, personalization, digital experience optimization, and customer education.

title: VP – Legal & Compliance
description:
About the Role

Wingify and AB Tasty are building one of the world's leading experimentation and digital experience platforms, helping thousands of businesses globally create better digital experiences and drive measurable growth.
With a global footprint spanning India, France, the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, Spain, Australia, Singapore, Canada, and Israel, the Group operates across multiple legal, regulatory, and commercial environments.

We are looking for a General Counsel/VP – Legal & Compliance to establish and lead the Group's global Legal & Compliance function.
This is a unique opportunity to join the executive leadership team and build the legal function from the ground up—shaping the organization's approach to commercial contracting, corporate governance, privacy, compliance, intellectual property, risk management, and strategic transactions.
The ideal candidate will be both strategic and hands-on: someone who can advise the CEO and Board on complex matters while also building scalable processes, frameworks, and a high-performing legal organization.


The Opportunity

As the Group's senior-most legal leader, you will be responsible for providing legal and strategic guidance across the business while building a scalable global legal infrastructure.
You will partner closely with the CEO, CFO, Board, and senior leadership team, as well as Product, Engineering, Sales, Finance, HR, Security, and other functions.

Your key areas of ownership will include:

Commercial & Technology Law

  • Lead the drafting, negotiation, and execution of enterprise SaaS and technology agreements, including MSAs, DPAs, NDAs, licensing agreements, partnership and reseller agreements, and vendor contracts.
  • Partner with Sales, Product, Engineering, Security, Finance, and other teams to provide practical, commercially focused legal guidance.
  • Build scalable contract templates, negotiation playbooks, approval frameworks, and legal workflows.
  • Establish processes that enable faster business execution while appropriately managing legal and commercial risk.
  • Manage external legal counsel across multiple jurisdictions and optimize legal spend.
  • Oversee disputes, claims, demand notices, and litigation, working toward commercially balanced outcomes.

Corporate Governance & Secretarial

  • Lead corporate governance and company secretarial matters across the Group's global entities.
  • Oversee board meetings, resolutions, statutory registers, regulatory filings, and governance documentation.
  • Advise on corporate structuring, investments, reorganizations, and strategic transactions.
  • Support M&A activities, including due diligence, transaction documentation, and post-transaction integration.
  • Coordinate with local legal and corporate secretarial advisors across jurisdictions.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable corporate and regulatory requirements across the Group.

Privacy, Compliance & Regulatory Affairs

  • Own and continuously strengthen the Group's global privacy and compliance framework.
  • Lead privacy and regulatory initiatives covering GDPR, CCPA, India's DPDP Act, and other applicable regulations.
  • Oversee the Group's Data Protection Officer (DPO) function.
  • Establish privacy-by-design and data governance practices across products and business operations.
  • Develop and maintain privacy notices, policies, DPAs, internal compliance frameworks, and related documentation.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and translate them into practical business recommendations.
  • Represent the organization, where appropriate, before regulators and oversee responses to regulatory inquiries, audits, and compliance matters.

Intellectual Property & Technology

  • Develop and execute the Group's IP strategy across trademarks, copyrights, patents, software, and other technology assets.
  • Advise on SaaS licensing, technology partnerships, AI-related legal matters, and emerging technology risks.
  • Oversee open-source software compliance and technology-related legal frameworks.
  • Protect and manage the Group's intellectual property portfolio and enforcement strategy.

Legal Risk & Disputes

  • Develop an enterprise-wide legal risk management framework.
  • Identify, assess, and proactively mitigate material legal and regulatory risks.
  • Oversee litigation, disputes, investigations, claims, and external counsel.
  • Provide senior leadership with clear, commercially grounded recommendations on complex and emerging risks.

Leadership & Business Partnership

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing global Legal & Compliance function.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO, CFO, Board, and executive leadership team.
  • Establish legal operating models, processes, KPIs, and governance mechanisms aligned with business priorities.
  • Develop legal and compliance awareness across the organization through training and enablement.
  • Present material legal, compliance, governance, and risk matters to executive leadership and the Board.
  • Build strong relationships with external counsel, regulators, advisors, and other strategic stakeholders.


What We're Looking For

  • 12–18 years of post-qualification legal experience, with significant experience in senior in-house legal leadership roles.
  • Experience working within a global technology, SaaS, software, internet, or similarly complex business environment.
  • LLB or equivalent law degree required; LLM or relevant postgraduate qualification is a plus.
  • Qualification to practice law in India is preferred/required depending on the candidate's primary jurisdiction.
  • Strong expertise in commercial contracting, technology law, corporate governance, privacy, and regulatory compliance.
  • Deep working knowledge of GDPR and familiarity with India's DPDP Act, CCPA, and other global privacy frameworks.
  • Proven experience managing legal matters across multiple international jurisdictions.
  • Strong exposure to M&A, due diligence, corporate restructuring, investments, shareholder arrangements, and strategic transactions.
  • Experience with intellectual property, software licensing, SaaS agreements, and open-source compliance.
  • Experience building or scaling an in-house legal function is highly desirable.
  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to balance legal risk with business objectives.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, influencing, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior executives and Boards.
  • Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.
  • French language proficiency and/or experience working with European businesses is a strong advantage.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, you will:
  • Establish a scalable global Legal & Compliance function and operating model.
  • Create consistent legal, contracting, governance, privacy, and compliance frameworks across the Group.
  • Improve the speed, consistency, and effectiveness of commercial contracting.
  • Strengthen the organization's global privacy and regulatory compliance posture.
  • Build strong partnerships with executive leadership and business teams.
  • Establish an effective approach to legal risk management and external counsel.
  • Support strategic business initiatives, investments, and M&A.
  • Build and develop a strong legal team capable of supporting the Group's continued global growth.

Why This Role?

This is not a traditional legal leadership role.
You will have the opportunity to shape the legal function of a growing global technology group, work directly with executive leadership, influence strategic decisions, and build the systems and team that will support the organization's next phase of international growth.
If you are a commercially minded legal leader who enjoys building, solving complex problems, and enabling business growth—not simply managing legal risk—we'd love to hear from you.


Job Location: Gurugram / Delhi NCR. Candidates based in or willing to relocate to the Delhi NCR region are preferred.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Client Services
description:
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is comfortable working with Vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS to build and customize frontend solutions, debug complex client-side issues using browser developer tools, and handle DOM manipulation, event handling, and dynamic UI updates. Should be confident analyzing APIs through Fetch/XHR requests, tracking DOM changes using MutationObserver and browser console techniques, and making real-time UI modifications using inspect element and custom scripts. The role also requires troubleshooting frontend issues across browsers and collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve real-world client scenarios while ensuring smooth and optimized user experiences.

Key Responsibilities:

Examples of Tasks You Will Perform

  • Rearranging elements on a page dynamically.
  • Creating new UI blocks using JavaScript, jQuery and CSS.
  • Overriding existing styles safely.
  • Preventing interference from existing scripts and styles.
  • Ensuring compatibility across devices and screen sizes.
  • Making changes that survive dynamic DOM updates.
  • Tracking user interactions for experiments.

Key Skills Required

  • Strong understanding of Vanilla JavaScript, jQuery, HTML and CSS.
  • Advanced DOM traversal and manipulation.
  • Event handling and debugging in live environments.
  • Using MutationObservers for dynamic content.
  • Handling Single Page Applications (SPAs).
  • Writing safe and conflict-free CSS.
  • Understanding browser behaviour and edge cases.
  • Performance-safe scripting on production websites.

Important Mindset Difference

This role is highly problem-solving oriented. There is no clean HTML, no reusable components, and often no documentation. You must analyse the DOM like a detective and figure out how to safely manipulate it in real-time.

Who Will Enjoy This Role

  • Developers who love JavaScript, jQuery and CSS deeply.
  • Those who enjoy solving DOM challenges.
  • People are comfortable working without access to source code.
  • Developers who like debugging tricky real-world issues.
We don’t build websites — we intelligently manipulate the DOM using Vanilla JavaScript, jQuery and CSS to run experiments on live websites.

title: PreSales Solutions Engineer - ANZ
description:
Join Wingify as a Solutions Engineer: be the tech bridge in pre-sales, deliver data-driven demos, align product with client needs, and drive enterprise value.

THE TEAM

Team name & location: Solutions Engineers, based in India Remote, part of Wingify’s global PreSales team across the APAC & Emerging Markets. You report to Sonil Luthra and work closely with Natalia Gamarra, Beccky Peebles, Atul Gaur, and other Account Executives, Key Account Managers and Product Managers — and externally with prospects and existing clients.

Role overview: The Solutions Engineer acts as the technical bridge between prospects and Wingify's platform, accelerating the sales cycle and driving enterprise revenue. The goal on every deal: the Technical Win — the moment the prospect's team agrees we are the best solution for their requirements.
Tech stack & tools: JS, HTML, CSS, APIs, Salesforce, Realm, Loom, Jira, Confluence, Requestly, Postman, Claude / ChatGPT.

YOUR MISSION

  • Manage the technical and product relationship with prospects and customers, serving as a trusted point of contact throughout the sales cycle.
  • Build and maintain tailored solution presentations by analyzing prospect websites and delivering smart, data-driven insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Drive alignment between market needs and product innovation by providing feedback to product development teams and staying ahead of industry trends.
  • Lead end-to-end pre-sales efforts, from demonstrations and RFP responses to scoping and pricing, with minimal support.
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders and clients to ensure a smooth transition from pre-sales to implementation, while communicating new product capabilities clearly and effectively.
  • Act as the technical voice in high-level discussions with engineering, management, and executive stakeholders, demonstrating value and feasibility of Wingify's solutions.

BEYOND DEALS

  • Competitive intelligence: track competitors, sharpen our differentiation, anticipate landmines.
  • Evangelism: webinars, partner events, community.
  • Team knowledge: demo scripts, recording library, shared learnings, and more.

HOW WE WORK

  • You engage on qualified opportunities
  • Every demo runs Tell-Show-Tell: the pain, the workflow, the impact. Customisation scales with the deal.
  • Success is measured on how you influence the Revenue — and on the Technical Win.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Proven experience in pre-sales engineering in a SaaS environment, with 5yrs+ years supporting sales and service delivery for enterprise clients.
  • Confidence in customer-facing communication, technical analysis, solution positioning, and navigating complex RFI/RFP processes.
  • Eagerness to combine strong technical foundations (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, web technologies, APIs) with a passion for helping clients unlock product value.
  • Working knowledge of CRO: A/B testing methodology and statistics, web and product analytics.
  • Fluency in English, with the ability to adapt your story from developer to C-level.
If you don't meet 100% of these qualifications, tell us why you'd still be a great fit for this role in your application!

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  1. Discovery Interview with Talent Acquisition team.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview with Sonil Luthra.
  3. Interview with the Regional Sales Team – Becky Peebles and Natalia Gamarra, Regional Sales Leader.
  4. Final Meeting with Julien Crochet, VP, Revenue Strategy & Operations.

At Wingify, we are committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives drives better ideas, stronger execution, and more meaningful impact.

title: Technical Account Manager - Customer support specialist - US
description:
Wingify is a remote-first company with more than $100M in revenue, serving over 4,000 customers worldwide, supported by a team of nearly 800 talented people across 11 global offices. We pride ourselves on innovation, customer focus, and a collaborative remote work culture.
About the Role:
We are seeking a proactive and customer-centric Technical Account Manager- customer support specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be the dedicated technical point of contact for assigned customers, ensuring all their queries and issues related to the product are addressed promptly. You will leverage your technical expertise and customer service skills to build strong relationships, resolve complex issues, and drive product adoption. This role requires a strong understanding of web technologies and a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of web technologies and SaaS products.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working with remote teams.

title: Senior SDR - Inbound/Outbound (UK)
description:
About Wingify
Founded in 2009, Wingify was built with a simple mission: to make experimentation and experience optimization accessible to everyone. What began in a New Delhi apartment has grown into a global SaaS platform enabling organizations to improve digital experiences through data-driven experimentation and insight.
Today, Wingify serves thousands of customers—from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 companies like the World Economic Forum, Genpact, Forbes, and LEGO—and is supported by a global team of 450+ employees, with ANZ emerging as a key growth region.

Following Wingify’s merger with AB Tasty, the combined organization now forms a larger digital experience optimization platform with $100M+ in annual recurring revenue, 4,000+ customers worldwide, and nearly 800 employees across 11 global offices. Led by Sparsh Gupta as CEO and backed by Everstone, the group is focused on delivering best-in-class experimentation, personalization, and AI-led optimization solutions at global scale.

Role Overview
As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Wingify, you will play a pivotal role in driving our growth. You’ll be responsible for generating qualified opportunities through proactive outreach, thoughtful follow-up on inbound leads, and collaboration with Marketing and Sales teams to build a strong, predictable pipeline.

SDRs at Wingify are the first point of contact for prospective customers. You’ll combine curiosity, research, and persistence to uncover business challenges, understand digital optimization goals, and position Wingify's solutions to the right stakeholders.

Working closely with Account Executives (AEs), you’ll execute account-based strategies, leverage data-driven insights, and use leading tools such as Salesforce and LinkedIn Sales Navigator to deliver meaningful engagement.

This is an ideal opportunity for a self-starter who is passionate about technology, digital experience, and customer success, and eager to grow their career within a high-growth SaaS environment.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Promote Wingify: Conduct extensive cold calling, emails, and communications to prospective clients.
  • Respond to Inbound Leads: Efficiently manage and respond to inbound leads generated from various channels.
  • Lead Research: Identify and evaluate leads through thorough web and CRM research.
  • Meet Quotas: Achieve or exceed the quota of a minimum of 50 calls / 30 emails per day with 7-9 connections.
  • Demo Scheduling: Schedule and provide detailed information for productive demos.
  • CRM Management: Maintain and update all contacts/opportunities in Salesforce.
  • Prospecting & Lead Generation: Handle prospecting, lead generation, sales qualification, and initial customer calls to ensure the team meets annual revenue targets.
  • Market Research: Discover new sectors and organizations through detailed market research.
  • Outbound Campaigns: Execute targeted outbound campaigns to generate new leads.
  • Sales Funnel Management: Manage both inbound and outbound sales funnels and qualify prospects.
  • Decision-Maker Identification: Pinpoint key decision-makers within organizations.
  • Lead Development: Cultivate leads that can turn into valuable business opportunities.

Requirements:
  • Experience: 2+ years in sales or business development, preferably in SaaS, business intelligence, or consulting.
  • Fearless Attitude: Willingness to take intelligent risks and achieve high activity levels.
  • Data Savvy: Strong understanding of data application in decision-making processes.
  • Communication Skills: Ability to effectively communicate prospects’ requirements internally.
  • Creative Problem Solver: Ability to think on your feet and keep the sales funnel active.
  • Metrics-Driven: Data-driven, measuring every step of the sales process.
  • Proven Track Record: Demonstrated ability to articulate product selling points.
  • Positive Attitude: Ability to handle rejection positively and maintain strong relationships.
  • Self-Motivated: Must be self-driven, persistent, and able to work independently.

Perks & Benefits:
  • Remote-First Organization: Flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Group Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage for you and your family.
  • International Offsites: Participate in annual company retreats to global destinations.
  • Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary with performance incentives.
  • Learning Opportunities: Engage in incredible learning experiences within international teams.


At Wingify, we are committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives drives better ideas, stronger execution, and more meaningful impact. Read more about our policy here: https://wingify.com/careers/equal-opportunity-policy/
